stories.title: Trump anuncia una tregua energética de carácter “inmediato” entre Rusia y Ucrania

en.title: Trump announces immediate energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
en.summary: Trump stated that Russia and Ukraine have reached an agreement on an immediate energy sector ceasefire. Ukrainian President Zelenski expressed surprise at the announcement but indicated his support for it.

stories.title: Doble Puerta Grande en Las Ventas: Antonio Ferrera y Román protagonizan una tarde apasionada y libre

en.title: Double Puerta Grande at Las Ventas: Antonio Ferrera and Román star in a passionate and free afternoon
en.summary: Two bullfighters achieved the honor of exiting through the Puerta Grande gate at Madrid's Las Ventas bullring during an afternoon performance. The event featured notable displays of skill and bravery from both matadors.

stories.title: Podemos y ERC, «muy cerca» de un pacto en Cataluña al margen del Frente Amplio

en.title: Podemos and ERC, "very close" to a pact in Catalonia outside the Broad Front
en.summary: Podemos and the Republican Left of Catalonia are negotiating a potential agreement in the region, separate from broader leftist coalition discussions. The talks follow clarification that ERC's Gabriel Rufián will remain with his party.

stories.title: Trump anuncia otro «alto el fuego energético» entre Rusia y Ucrania, pero Putin sigue con los ataques

en.title: Trump announces another "energy ceasefire" between Russia and Ukraine, but Putin continues attacks
en.summary: Trump announced an immediate ceasefire on energy sector attacks between Russia and Ukraine, claiming both sides agreed. However, reports indicate continued Russian military operations despite the announcement.

stories.title: Rufián firma la paz con Junqueras para liderar ERC y negocia una alianza con Podemos que puede reventar el Frente Amplio

en.title: Rufián signs peace with Junqueras to lead ERC and negotiates an alliance with Podemos that could break up the Broad Front
en.summary: ERC leadership resolved internal divisions and is exploring collaboration options with Podemos while setting aside previous controversies about coalition building with other Spanish left-wing parties.

stories.title: El Papa anuncia que le van a operar de un nódulo en el pulmón en los próximos días

en.title: Pope announces he will undergo surgery for lung nodule in coming days
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV announced that he will have surgery to remove a lung nodule discovered during a recent medical examination. The nodule is in an early stage and well-located, with the procedure scheduled for early this week at Gemelli Hospital, where doctors expect a seven-day hospitalization.

stories.title: Trump anuncia una tregua energética entre Ucrania y Rusia, pero Zelenski dice desconocerla

en.title: Trump announces energy truce between Ukraine and Russia, but Zelenski says he is unaware of it
en.summary: Trump announced an energy truce between Ukraine and Russia. Ukrainian leader Zelenski expressed support for a ceasefire but stated he was unaware of the announcement and requested guarantees and reciprocal commitment from the Kremlin.

stories.title: Zelenski propone a Rusia una tregua de ataques a instalaciones energéticas tras el pacto entre Trump y Putin

en.title: Zelenski proposes ceasefire on energy infrastructure attacks to Russia following Trump-Putin agreement
en.summary: Ukraine's president seeks genuine guarantees to reach agreements on halting attacks on energy facilities. The Kremlin dismisses the proposal as irrational.

stories.title: El Papa anuncia que tiene un nódulo en un pulmón y va a ser operado

en.title: Pope announces he has a lung nodule and will undergo surgery
en.summary: The pontiff revealed a nodule detected in an early stage requiring surgical intervention. He confirmed his planned trip to Latin America on November 6.

stories.title: Sánchez pide al Supremo que “frene el intento de atropello” de Feijóo y Abascal y permita votar a los descendientes del exilio

en.title: Sánchez urges Supreme Court to "halt attempted abuse" by Feijóo and Abascal and allow exile descendants to vote
en.summary: Spanish President Sánchez asked the Supreme Court to stop what he characterized as an overreach by Feijóo and Abascal regarding voting rights for descendants of exiles. He continued to emphasize housing rights during a campaign rally in Ponferrada.

stories.title: El Papa anuncia que deberá operarse de un nódulo en el pulmón en fase "muy inicial"

en.title: Pope announces surgery scheduled for lung nodule in early stage
en.summary: The pontiff will undergo surgical intervention in the coming days for a nodule detected at an initial stage, with one week of post-operative hospitalization expected.

stories.title: El papa León XIV anuncia que será operado de un nódulo en el pulmón

en.title: Pope Leo XIV announces he will undergo surgery for lung nodule
en.summary: The pontiff confirmed detection of a nodule in an early stage requiring surgical intervention within the coming days.

stories.title: Frux capta 350 millones y prepara un nuevo fondo para 'data center'

en.title: Frux raises 350 million and prepares new data center fund
en.summary: Frux Capital, a private debt manager specialized in real estate, closed its third fund with commitments of 350 million euros, 60% more than the previous one. The firm is also preparing a dedicated 200-million-euro vehicle focused on data centers.

stories.title: Iberia pide activar un nuevo control de pasaportes en la T4 para ganar vuelos de largo

en.title: Iberia requests activation of new passport control at T4 to gain long-haul flights
en.summary: Iberia seeks to activate additional passport control facilities at Terminal 4 for non-Schengen flights that currently lack staffing. The airline industry estimates this could increase capacity by approximately 50 daily flights.

stories.title: Volvo disparará rentabilidad con las ventas de Lynk & Co

en.title: Volvo will boost profitability with Lynk & Co sales
en.summary: Volvo will distribute vehicles from Lynk & Co, owned by Chinese conglomerate Geely, through its dealership network. The arrangement is expected to increase sales volume and profit margins for Volvo dealers.

stories.title: Pensiones, agua y Europa: así quiere cambiar Burnham Reino Unido

en.title: Pensions, water and Europe: how Burnham wants to change the United Kingdom
en.summary: British Prime Minister Burnham announces plans in his early weeks to adjust pensions, increase public control over essential services, and encourage more young people to enter the workforce.

stories.title: IESE, ESCP e IE, en el 'top 15' de mejores MBA a ejecutivos

en.title: IESE, ESCP and IE, in the 'top 15' of best executive MBAs
en.summary: Three Spanish business schools rank among the world's top executive MBA programs, with IESE ranked third globally, IE at number 13, and ESCP with a Madrid campus at fifth place.
